operations.name: list_users
operations.title: List users
operations.description:
Only Service Users with Administrator permissions can access this list.

params.description: Unique user ID

params.name: username
params.description: Username (login)

params.name: account_id
params.description: Associated account ID

params.name: state
params.description: User state (e.g. active)

params.name: multi_factor_auth_enabled
params.description: If true, MFA is enabled for this user

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of objects to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of objects to skip (pagination)

operations.description:
Body must be a base64-encoded file. See query params for metadata.

operations.title: Delete documents in folder by filter

params.name: id
params.description: Annotation ID

params.description: Set to true to select pre-built annotations and to false to select custom annotations; omit to include both.

params.description: Set true to format time-period content for display.

operations.name: create_document_annotations_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Create document annotations (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Create document wide annotations. Only 'generic' and 'entity' annotation types are supported and 'generic' type annotations are exclusive (limited to 1 instance) per document. To create an annotation, the matching annotation type must be active and enabled for the project.

POST /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations

content.description: Type-specific annotation content, validated against the annotation type.
Type-specific annotation content, validated against the annotation type.

operations.name: update_document_annotations_by_filter_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Update document annotations by filter (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Replace the content field on matching annotations. At least one query parameter is required (excluding non-filtering parameters 'pretty', 'limit' and 'offset'). All matched annotations must have the same annotation type and the annotation type cannot be Pre-Built or configured as 'blacklisted for modification'. An empty match returns an empty array.

PATCH /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations

params.name: id
params.description: Annotation ID

params.name: pre_built
params.description: If true, this will filter to annotations with a a pre-built annotation type resulting in an error (422 status code) because instances of pre-built annotation types cannot be updated. Leave as false or undefined to filter to annotations with a custom (non pre-built) annotation type which can be updated.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Set true to format time-period content for display.

content.description: Type-specific annotation content, all values are validated against the annotation type

operations.name: delete_document_annotations_by_filter_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Delete document annotations by filter (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Delete matching document annotations. At least one query parameter is required (excluding non-filtering parameters 'pretty', 'limit' and 'offset'). Annotations with an annotation type that is Pre-Built or configured as 'blacklisted for modification' can not be deleted.

DELETE /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations

params.name: roles
params.description: Annotation role keys. Use repeated roles query parameters for an array.

params.name: content
params.description: Annotation content filter.

params.name: pre_built
params.description: If true, this will filter to annotations with a a pre-built annotation type resulting in an error (422 status code) because instances of pre-built annotation types cannot be deleted. Leave as false or undefined to filter to annotations with a custom (non pre-built) annotation type which can be deleted.

operations.name: update_document_annotation_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Update document annotation (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Replace the content for one document annotation, only the content can be changed. Annotations that match an annotation type that is Pre-Built or configured as 'blacklisted for modification' cannot be updated.

PATCH /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations/{annotation_id}

content.description: Type-specific annotation content, all values are validated against the annotation type

operations.name: delete_document_annotation_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Delete document annotation (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Delete a document annotation. Annotations that match an annotation type that is Pre-Built or configured as 'blacklisted for modification' cannot be deleted.

DELETE /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations/{annotation_id}

operations.name: retrieve_annotation_text_folder_scoped_path
operations.title: Retrieve annotation text (folder-scoped path)
operations.description:
Return text at each annotation position and at its content.evidence_positions. Only id and fullParagraph query parameters are accepted.

GET /api2/projects/{project_id}/folders/{folder_id}/documents/{document_id}/annotations/annotationText

params.name: id
params.description: Annotation IDs. Pass one id or repeat the query parameter, for example id=1&id=2. Duplicate IDs are ignored.

params.name: fullParagraph
params.description: Set true to expand root annotation text to full paragraphs. Evidence text is not expanded.

operations.name: list_document_templates_in_project
operations.title: List document templates in project
operations.description:
Contract/document templates for the project. Use GET .../document_templates/{id}/fields to get the schema required for contract creation.

GET /api2/projects/{project_id}/document_templates

params.name: id
params.description: Filter by document template ID

params.name: default_folder_id
params.description: Folder ID where documents created from this template are saved

params.name: state
params.description: active or deleted

params.name: media_type
params.description: Media type (e.g. MS Word MIME type)

operations.name: get_document_template_fields_for_contract_creation
operations.title: Get document template fields (for contract creation)

operations.name: create_contract_matter_generated_document_from_template
operations.title: Create contract (matter + generated document from template)
operations.description:
Get template fields from GET .../document_templates/{id}/fields; the data object keys match field keys (e.g. singleInputFieldKey for type datatag). For nested/loop fields use arrays of objects. See docuvault Contract Creation and Postman Contract Generation collection.

POST /api2/projects/{project_id}/document_templates/create

schema.description: Payload for POST document_templates/create (contract creation). Get field keys from GET .../document_templates/{id}/fields; pass values in data keyed by field keys (e.g. singleInputFieldKey from fields of type datatag).

data.description: Key-value map of template field keys to values
